description: SimCenter Labeled Building Facades from Street View is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Sanjay Govindjee, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). We present an annotated dataset to advance the efficacy of object recognition of building facades in the context of street scene understanding for analysis of natural hazards on the built environment. We gathered images of complex street scenes containing building objects in their natural context. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-z5ra-2260. Keywords: SimCenter, Natural Hazards, Images, Annotations, Labels, Street View. Published 2021-12-15. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
